title: Morpho Vortex Elixir
description: A vibrant, ornate glass potion bottle sits centered on a marble pedestal draped in purple cloth. The bottle features swirling patterns of teal, emerald, red, and gold with white butterfly motifs, sealed with a red cord and a paper tag. Its stopper is a detailed green insectoid creature with large red compound eyes and golden antennae, set against a mystical purple background with floating colorful smoke swirls.
prompt: A highly detailed ornate glass potion bottle with swirling teal, green, red and gold patterns and small white butterflies, sealed with a red cord and labeled Morpho Vortex Elixir. The stopper is a shiny green insectoid creature with large red compound eyes and golden antennae. The bottle rests on a white marble pedestal covered with purple velvet cloth, set in an alchemist's study with purple swirling background and colorful magical smoke trails.
